page.title: Overview
page.description: What is on your menu right now, and what is still missing.

logo.label: Your logo
logo.hint: It sits at the top of your menu.

cover.label: A cover photo
cover.hint: The first thing guests see when the menu opens.

description.label: A short description
description.hint: One line under your name on the menu.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.hint: Guests see whether you are open right now.

location.label: Your location
location.hint: Guests get a map and directions.

phone.label: A phone number
phone.hint: Guests can call you, chat on WhatsApp, and send orders.

categories.label: A category
categories.hint: Categories are the tabs guests move between.

dishes.label: A dish
dishes.hint: Nothing shows on your menu until it has dishes.

photos.label: Dish photos
photos.hint: A photo shows guests what they are ordering.

social.label: A social link
social.hint: Guests can follow you from the menu.

setup.title: Set up your menu
setup.complete: Your menu is ready: everything guests look for is on it.
setup.incomplete: Three steps, each with what is still missing.

restaurant.title: Your restaurant
restaurant.description: Who you are and how guests reach you: shown at the top of your menu.

menu.title: Your dishes
menu.description: What you serve, in categories guests move between.

share.title: Share your menu
share.description: Put the QR code on your tables, and link the places guests follow you.

guide.title: How it works
guide.description: Your menu, on every guest's phone.

fill.title: Fill in your menu
fill.body: Add your dishes, prices and photos here. They show on your menu link.

share.title: Put the QR code on your tables
share.body: Guests scan it with their phone camera. No app to download.

change.title: Change it any time
change.body: A new price or a dish sold out is live at once. Nothing to reprint.
